value: **Involvement**: Teachers actively participated in collaborative co-design workshops, design meetings, or teacher communities with researchers to iteratively develop, test, and adapt curriculum units, assessments, and lesson plans. **Evidence**: "It was necessary to leverage all co-designers’ knowledge and skills to develop agricultural curriculum materials that could be accessed, adapted, and enacted by informal and school-based educators (Gutiérrez & Jurow, 2016)."
